name: Behistun Inscription
notes: Trilingual (Old Persian, Elamite, Babylonian) cliff inscription of Darius I. Copied by Henry Rawlinson 1835-1847 at great physical risk; publication of the Old Persian decipherment 1846-1847 was the key that unlocked Babylonian/Akkadian cuneiform, publicly confirmed via the 1857 Royal Asiatic Society blind-translation test (Rawlinson, Hincks, Oppert, and Fox Talbot working independently on a newly discovered text).
